parole.testo: Pseudo-Latinism, derived from ambi- (“both”) + valentia (“strength”), coined as a calque of German Ambivalenz, equivalent to ambi- + valência. Cognate with Aragonese, Asturian, Galician, and Spanish ambivalencia, Catalan ambivalència, French ambivalence, Italian ambivalenza, and Romanian ambivalență

parole.significato: Wend (a member of a Slavic people from the borders of Germany and Poland)
parole.testo: Possibly derived from Latin Vendum or borrowed from German Wende. Compare Spanish vendo.
